definitions.explanation: Calling out names or numbers to check attendance, typically in military, school, workplace, or emergency contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点呼|てんこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点呼|てんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とった。
examples.english: After the evacuation, a head count of everyone was taken.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{出発前|しゅっぱつまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点呼|てんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The bus driver conducted a roll call of passengers before departure.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point/check) + {呼|こ} (call). The act of calling names or numbers to verify attendance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点呼|てんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とる: to take roll call
- {点呼|てんこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a roll call
- {点呼|てんこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct a roll call (formal)
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点呼|てんこ}: morning roll call

USAGE:
Used in settings where attendance verification is important:
- ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧: military
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: school (especially field trips, evacuations)
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}{訓練|くんれん}→避難訓練：28230_hinankunren⟧: evacuation drills
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧: construction sites

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出欠|しゅっけつ}→出欠：09604_shukketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とる: to take attendance (classroom setting, more everyday)
- ⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: headcount/confirmation of numbers
